Provident Real Estate is proud to present this exquisite five-bedroom beachfront villa in Sur La Mer — Jumeirah's first and only freehold waterfront community. Inspired by Italian Mediterranean architecture and set across four expansive levels, this residence is a masterclass in refined coastal living.

Property Details:

5 Bedrooms | All En-Suite
6 Bathrooms | 2 Powder Rooms
BUA: 6,841 Sq. Ft | Plot: 8,364 Sq. Ft
G+2+Roof | Private Lift
Maid's Room | Study | Family Room
Entertainment Rooftop & BBQ Area
3 Allocated Parking Spaces
Direct Beach & Sea Views

Community Amenities:

Private Beach & Marina Access
1KM Waterfront Promenade
Clubhouse | Pool & Kids Pool
Kids Play Areas | Cycling Tracks
EV Charging | Boutique Waterfront Dining
Prime Location:

5 Mins to City Walk & J1 Beach
10 Mins to Downtown & Burj Khalifa
15 Mins to Dubai International Airport
Offered at the most competitive price currently listed, this villa represents an unmatched opportunity to secure beachfront luxury in one of Dubai's most prestigious addresses.
